svg.title: NetCDF: one container, many scientific worlds
svg.desc: Dimensions describe shape. Variables carry values. Coordinates and attributes make those values interpretable across disciplines.
svg.text: NetCDF: one container, many scientific worlds
Dimensions describe shape. Variables carry values. Coordinates and attributes make those values interpretable across disciplines.
Values travel with the context needed to read them
indexes become physical places and times
Enhanced netCDF-4 adds groups, multiple unlimited dimensions, and user-defined types.
Rank is an arrangement of axes, not a fixed domain
vertical profile, atmosphere or ocean layer
evolving field through space and time
The same dimension set can be sliced, aggregated, or resampled according to the question.
Rank is a reusable axis arrangement, not a domain label.
3 · The same primitives answer different scientific questions
Change the variables and conventions; keep the container contract
forecast map · anomaly field · seasonal aggregate
Coordinates and quality metadata preserve domain meaning
Coordinates and quality metadata preserve domain meaning
false-color composite · cloud mask · calibrated tile
Coordinates and quality metadata preserve domain meaning
basin summary · exceedance map · station series
Coordinates and quality metadata preserve domain meaning
Coordinates and quality metadata preserve domain meaning
The container contract stays stable across disciplines; variable names, units, axes, and quality conventions change.
That lets the same reader share map, profile, section, and volume workflows.
4 · From stored structure to a useful result
Select the smallest meaningful slice, then pass it to the next tool
Find the variable, time window, level, and region that answer the question.
Check CF meaning, missing-value rules, and quality flags before comparing values.
Keep the smallest useful subset and preserve the coordinates that explain it.
Send the derived result to visualization, statistics, simulation, or a shared archive.
1. General model: groups, dimensions, variables, attributes, coordinate conventions, and N-dimensional arrays.
2. Current subset: file metadata, variables, dimensions, global attributes, bounded grid values, rank 1–4, CF numeric auxiliary coordinates, selected CRS, and resumable slices.
3. Do not read this companion as a claim that the importer implements every NetCDF-4 feature or every domain convention.
